NGA.note: Galaxy Backbone's data centre hosting is described for government bodies only; no hire to outside customers is stated.
Galaxy Backbone is named by directive as the government data exchange platform, but the document does not say it is live, being built or piloted, or what it links.

facts.fact: A circular issued through the Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation orders ministries, departments and agencies hosting official data on foreign platforms to migrate to government-owned Galaxy Backbone, under a policy to safeguard digital sovereignty, as Galaxy Backbone's chief executive says.
facts.system: OSGF circular on migration of MDA hosting to Galaxy Backbone

NGA.note: Only an expectation that e-government rollout will accelerate; no service is stated online.

facts.fact: Galaxy Backbone, the government-owned technology company, is mandated by the circular to deliver IP-network connectivity, data centre hosting and other digital infrastructure for ministries, departments and agencies.

NGA.note: Government bodies are ordered to migrate to Galaxy Backbone, but the document does not state their data is already hosted there or that it sells hosting to outside customers.
